canonical_title: Installation of the parachute in the airframe

versions.title_at_revision: Installation of the parachute in the airframe
versions.text:
Consideration shall be given to the following aspects of the parachute installation:
(a) The packing of the parachute, installation in the airframe and attachments to the airframe should take account of all potential operational conditions and in particular, launch accelerations, which may affect its safety.
(b) All components of the parachute landing system should be made for ventilation and drainage of the parachute canister and associated structure to ensure the sound condition of the system.
(c) Adequate means should be provided to permit the close examination of the parachute and other system components to ensure proper functioning, alignment, lubrication, and adjustment during the required inspection of the system.
(d) Each fitting point of the parachute straps and the surrounding structures should be designed for the maximum expected opening loads with a safety factor not less than 1.5.
(e) The installation of the parachute in the airframe should be designed in order to mitigate the effects of possible oscillation of the UAV once the parachute is deployed in the air and at the impact on the ground.

Consideration shall be given to the following aspects of the parachute installation:
(a) The packing of the parachute, installation in the airframe and attachments to the airframe should take account of all potential operational conditions and in particular, launch accelerations, which may affect its safety.

(c) Adequate means should be provided to permit the close examination of the parachute and other system components to ensure proper functioning, alignment, lubrication, and adjustment during the required inspection of the system.
